Name: SoulCalibur Weapons
Author: Lucidvisionsinc
Description:
[center]﻿﻿﻿🗡️ Soul Calibur Weapons Mod - Unleash Legendary Power!
Dive into a world of legendary swords with the Soul Calibur Weapons Mod! Discover a stunning collection of powerful blades, each with its own unique spirit and magical abilities. However, before you embark on this epic adventure, we must share some important information.[/center]


-Current weapons-
-Soul Calibur-
A sword with a spirit, forged from sacrifice, destined to defeat the malevolent Soul Edge.
Requirements:
[spoiler]-Able to purchase from Marlon at 4 hearts, after obtaining the Galaxy Sword.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]-You have a small chance of acquiring it in the mines after level 100. Not sure how the probability works.(It's Set to 20)[/spoiler]

-Soul Edge-
Once an ordinary sword, now a malevolent demon, cursed by its own wicked history.
Requirements:
[spoiler]-Price $90000 Purchase from Krobus at 4 hearts, must have the Galaxy Sword, and small chance of acquiring it in the mines after level 100.[/spoiler]
[spoiler]-Price $75000 Purchase from Dwarf at 4 hearts, must have the Galaxy Sword, %30 percent chance, and small chance of acquiring it in the mines after level 100.[/spoiler]

-Omega Sword -
A formidable blade that can rival the might of any foe.
Requirements:
 [spoiler]Price- $70000 purchase from Marlon at 2 hearts/ must have galaxy sword.
Also can be found in the mines after you reach level 100.[/spoiler]

-Elk Shield-
A reliable shield to protect you from danger.
Requirements:
[spoiler]$30000 purchase from Marlon at 2 hearts.[/spoiler]

[center]The adventure doesn't end here! I am constantly working to improve this mod and provide you with the ultimate experience. If you encounter any bugs, kindly report them, and we'll ensure a swift resolution.

Embark on this epic journey, but remember, wield these powerful weapons with care. The fate of your farm and Stardew Valley lies in your hands.[/center]
